videos.desc: In an anime-style seaside kitchen a girl takes a spoon from a cutlery drawer, admires it in the window light, scoops steaming soup from a pot to taste, then happily eats a whole bowl of soup with the spoon until it is empty.
videos.said: Mm-hmm. Ah-ha!

videos.desc: A woman in an apron kneads and shapes bread dough, scores it and puts it in the oven; she and her partner watch the loaf rise through the glass, then pull out the golden bread, set it on a rack and smell it happily.
videos.said: Not near! Let it rise! Listen, perfect!

videos.desc: In a hand-painted mountain hut a girl in a red shawl tends a copper pot over an open fire; the water goes from still to small bubbles to a rolling boil with steam, and she lifts the pot with a cloth and pours the boiling water into a clay teapot.
videos.said: Ready!

videos.desc: A 3D-animated man cooks a pancake in a smoking frying pan in his kitchen; when he tips the pan onto the plate the pancake is completely black and charred, and he stares at it in shock saying 'Oops'.
videos.said: Oops

videos.desc: In a home kitchen a woman pours liquid cream into a metal bowl and a man whisks it until stiff peaks form, shows the peaks on the whisk saying "solid", even holds the bowl upside down over his head, then they spoon the whipped cream onto waffles with berries and taste it.
videos.said: Peaks! Look at that! See? Solid!

videos.desc: A young man's first egg crumbles and he grumbles while picking shell bits out of the bowl, his cat watching from the window. He cracks a fresh egg into a buttered pan, fries it sunny-side up, slides it onto toast and dips the bread into the runny golden yolk, eating with yolk on his chin.
videos.said: Shell not again The deep gold

videos.desc: In a rustic kitchen a man scoops white flour, sifts it over a wooden table like snow, presses handprints into it, then kneads it with water into dough. He ends up with flour on his nose and face and jokes about it with a woman while a dog watches.
videos.said: Let it snow! Got you! Classic!

videos.desc: A woman in a kitchen smashes a garlic bulb with her palm, breaks it into cloves and peels one; she sniffs it, winces at the strong smell, then drops it into a pan of hot oil and she and her partner sniff the delicious steam.
videos.said: Smash skins off. That smell incredible.

videos.desc: A couple at an old white stove turns the knob and the gas burner lights with a blue flame; they watch it burn, set a kettle on it, then start frying red onions in an oiled pan over the flame.
videos.said: Look at it go

videos.desc: On an evening patio a man wipes the hot bars of a charcoal grill, lays out peppers, tomatoes and a slab of white cheese, flips the cheese to show dark criss-cross grill stripes and serves everything on a plate.
videos.said: Two seconds, ready? The stripes, look!

videos.desc: In a bright kitchen, a man uses a large knife to slice a loaf of bread and then a tomato, builds an open sandwich with the slices, and a couple gives a thumbs up while tasting it.
videos.said: (upbeat music) (upbeat music)

videos.desc: In a rustic kitchen, a man tastes a spoonful of bright yellow mustard from a stone bowl and winces at its sharp taste. He whisks the mustard with honey into a glaze, brushes it over a tray of carrots, and a woman tastes the result and reacts with delighted surprise.
videos.said: Ooh, sharp! Sweet and sharp, wow!

videos.desc: A man peels a white onion, halves it on a cutting board and starts slicing, but his eyes water and he wipes tears while a woman behind him cries too. He then puts on blue swim goggles, gives a thumbs up, and happily finishes chopping the onion.
videos.said: My eyes! Goggles! Genius!

videos.desc: A young couple slides a tray of raw bread dough into a kitchen oven and crouches at the glass door, watching the light inside as the loaf rises and turns golden. Wearing oven mitts, they pull out the finished brown loaf, thrilled.
videos.said: Look how it's through!

videos.desc: In a rustic kitchen a man in an apron oils a steel frying pan, adds sliced peppers and onion, tosses the vegetables high in the pan while a woman watches amazed, then slides them onto a plate.
videos.said: Little one first! The big door!

videos.desc: In a hand-painted anime scene a girl with a braid sits on a porch above green fields and peels a red apple with a small knife in one long unbroken spiral that drops into a basket, then holds up the fully peeled pale apple.
videos.said: Ta-da!

videos.desc: A man in a bright kitchen grinds black pepper from a tall wooden pepper mill over a bowl of creamy pasta, then the pepper tickles his nose and he sneezes into his elbow before laughing and presenting the dish.
videos.said: (upbeat music) Grind, grind, grind. Ah, ah. (laughs)

videos.desc: A chef polishes a large white plate with a cloth, twirls spaghetti in tomato sauce onto its center with tongs, adds basil and a ring of olive oil, wipes the rim clean and proudly serves the plate to a delighted woman at a candlelit table.
videos.said: Chef's touch Dinner is served

videos.desc: In a rustic kitchen, a young couple fills a big metal pot with water, sets it over an open fire and tips small potatoes into it. They cover it with a lid, peek inside as it boils and joke that the water is "dancing", then lift a cooked potato out on a fork through the steam.
videos.said: Watching won't help. Look, it's dancing!

videos.desc: A couple in a kitchen follows a hand-drawn recipe card with icons for eggs, milk and a pan: they crack eggs, whisk batter, fry pancakes and finish a tall honey-topped stack, checking the card at each step.
videos.said: Step one, eggs. Just like the card.

videos.desc: In a stone kitchen by the sea, a hand pinches coarse white salt from a small wooden pot and sprinkles it over a board of ripe tomato slices while a seagull watches through the open window; a couple licks salt from their fingers and bites into the salted tomatoes with bread, delighted at the taste.
videos.said: Ooh! Salty! Perfect!

videos.desc: A 3D-animated young chef slices a tomato into a neat fan of thin rounds on a wooden board, then proudly holds one translucent slice up to the light with a big grin.
videos.said: Tada! Look!

videos.desc: A man lays a thick raw ribeye into a cast-iron pan over a gas flame, sears it, bastes it with butter and thyme, rests it under foil, then slices it open to show a pink center and tastes a piece while his beagle watches over the counter.
videos.said: That crust, listen. Rested, now perfect.
